44 // Header
45 struct sHeader {
46 // Frame Control
47 union uFrameControl {
48 uint16_t val; // Raw 16-bit value
49
50 // Bitfield
51 struct sFrameControl {
52#if __BYTE_ORDER__ == __ORDER_LITTLE_ENDIAN__
53 uint16_t protocol_version : 2; // Protocol version (currently is 0)
54 uint16_t type : 2; // Frame type (00 - Mgmt, 01 - Control, 10 - Data)
55 uint16_t subtype : 4; // Frame subtype (e.g. Assoc Req, Action etc.)
56 uint16_t to_ds : 1; // If destined to Distribution System
57 uint16_t from_ds : 1; // If originated from Distribution System
58 uint16_t more_fragments : 1; // If the frame is fragmented
59 uint16_t retry : 1; // Retransmission of the earlier frame
60 uint16_t power_mgmt : 1; // If power management is enabled
61 uint16_t more_data : 1; // TBD
62 uint16_t protected_frame : 1; // If the data is encrypted
63 uint16_t order : 1; // QoS
64#elif __BYTE_ORDER__ == __ORDER_BIG_ENDIAN__
65 uint16_t subtype : 4; // Frame subtype (e.g. Assoc Req, Action etc.)
66 uint16_t type : 2; // Frame type (00 - Mgmt, 01 - Control, 10 - Data)
67 uint16_t protocol_version : 2; // Protocol version (currently is 0)
68 uint16_t order : 1; // QoS
69 uint16_t protected_frame : 1; // If the data is encrypted
70 uint16_t more_data : 1; // TBD
71 uint16_t power_mgmt : 1; // If power management is enabled
72 uint16_t retry : 1; // Retransmission of the earlier frame
73 uint16_t more_fragments : 1; // If the frame is fragmented
74 uint16_t from_ds : 1; // If originated from Distribution System
75 uint16_t to_ds : 1; // If destined to Distribution System
76#endif
77 } __attribute__((packed)) bits;
78 } __attribute__((packed)) frame_control;
79
80 uint16_t duration; // Duration / ID
81 sMacAddr da; // Destination MAC Address
82 sMacAddr sa; // Source MAC Address
83 sMacAddr bssid; // BSSID (AP MAC Address)
84 uint16_t seq_ctrl; // Sequence number
85
86 } __attribute__((packed)) header;

143/*
144 * @brief channel width number from the standard IEEE 802.11-2020
145 * (Table 9-175 HT/VHT Operation Information subfields).
146 * (values 5-255 are reserved)
147 */
148enum eChanWidthNr : uint8_t {
149 NR_CHAN_WIDTH_20 = 0,
150 NR_CHAN_WIDTH_40 = 1,
151 NR_CHAN_WIDTH_80 = 2,
152 NR_CHAN_WIDTH_160 = 3,
153 NR_CHAN_WIDTH_80P80 = 4,
154 NR_CHAN_WIDTH_MAX,
155 NR_CHAN_WIDTH_UNKNOWN = 0xFF,
156};

158#define BIT(x) (1U << (x))

160/* HT Capabilities Info field within HT Capabilities element */
161#define HT_CAP_INFO_LDPC_CODING_CAP ((uint16_t)BIT(0))
162#define HT_CAP_INFO_SUPP_CHANNEL_WIDTH_SET ((uint16_t)BIT(1))
163#define HT_CAP_INFO_SMPS_MASK ((uint16_t)(BIT(2) | BIT(3)))
164#define HT_CAP_INFO_SMPS_STATIC ((uint16_t)0)
165#define HT_CAP_INFO_SMPS_DYNAMIC ((uint16_t)BIT(2))
166#define HT_CAP_INFO_SMPS_DISABLED ((uint16_t)(BIT(2) | BIT(3)))
167#define HT_CAP_INFO_GREEN_FIELD ((uint16_t)BIT(4))
168#define HT_CAP_INFO_SHORT_GI20MHZ ((uint16_t)BIT(5))
169#define HT_CAP_INFO_SHORT_GI40MHZ ((uint16_t)BIT(6))
170#define HT_CAP_INFO_TX_STBC ((uint16_t)BIT(7))
171#define HT_CAP_INFO_RX_STBC_MASK ((uint16_t)(BIT(8) | BIT(9)))
172#define HT_CAP_INFO_RX_STBC_1 ((uint16_t)BIT(8))
173#define HT_CAP_INFO_RX_STBC_12 ((uint16_t)BIT(9))
174#define HT_CAP_INFO_RX_STBC_123 ((uint16_t)(BIT(8) | BIT(9)))
175#define HT_CAP_INFO_DELAYED_BA ((uint16_t)BIT(10))
176#define HT_CAP_INFO_MAX_AMSDU_SIZE ((uint16_t)BIT(11))
177#define HT_CAP_INFO_DSSS_CCK40MHZ ((uint16_t)BIT(12))
178/* B13 - Reserved (was PSMP support during P802.11n development) */
179#define HT_CAP_INFO_40MHZ_INTOLERANT ((uint16_t)BIT(14))
180#define HT_CAP_INFO_LSIG_TXOP_PROTECT_SUPPORT ((uint16_t) BIT(15)
181
182/* Radio Measurement capabilities (from RM Enabled Capabilities element)
183 * IEEE Std 802.11-2016, 9.4.2.45, Table 9-157 */
184/* byte 1 (out of 5) */
185#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_LINK_MEASUREMENT BIT(0)
186#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_NEIGHBOR_REPORT BIT(1)
187#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_BEACON_REPORT_PASSIVE BIT(4)
188#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_BEACON_REPORT_ACTIVE BIT(5)
189#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_BEACON_REPORT_TABLE BIT(6)
190/* byte 2 (out of 5) */
191#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_CHANNEL_LOAD BIT(1)
192#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_NOISE_HISTOGRAM BIT(2)
193#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_STATISTICS_MEASUREMENT BIT(3)
194#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_LCI_MEASUREMENT BIT(4)
195/* byte 5 (out of 5) */
196#define WLAN_RRM_CAPS_FTM_RANGE_REPORT BIT(2)
